assets.name: frame
assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Production game UI sprite, not a mockup screenshot. Match ONLY the LEFT Briarwood & Iron theme from reference: hand-painted chunky low-poly medieval fantasy, rich dark timber, forged iron, aged brass, broad faceted painted bevels, restrained thorn carvings. Front-on orthographic flat sprite with genuinely transparent outside background, centered and uncropped. No text, no labels, no watermark, no scene, no ground shadow. Crisp silhouette, broad shapes and restrained texture, readable at small size. Make ONE square outer menu frame, near 1024 x 1024. Thick dark wooden perimeter, large dark iron corner plates and small brass rivets; sparse carved thorns near upper edge. Completely EMPTY TRANSPARENT interior window, NOT dark filled panel. Border thickness about 9% of square on all sides. Straight continuous middle sections for nine-slice scaling. NO central badge or crest on the top edge; it will be separately placed. Keep all four corners and every edge entirely in view with only 2% transparent outer padding.

assets.name: button
assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a PRODUCTION game button sprite, a SINGLE plain horizontal rectangle of carved dark brown timber inside a thin aged brass beveled rim with faceted corners. Briarwood & Iron stylized hand-painted low-poly fantasy. Exact 5:1 aspect ratio of the button silhouette. Genuinely transparent outside. Fill most image width and height with only 2% empty margin.
